{{Quote|This is Wag Too. He's a healer. He can make you well again.|Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Jedi Crash" />}}
'''Wag Too''' was a [[Lurmen]] healer and the son of [[Tee Watt Kaa]], the elder of [[Maridun]]'s [[Lurmen village]], who lived during the [[Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars]], Wag Too and other [[Lurmen]] lived in their [[Lurmen village|village]] on [[Maridun]]. However, they were then visited by [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight|Knight]] [[Aayla Secura]], [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Bly]] after they crash-landed. At first, his [[Parent|father]], [[Tee Watt Kaa]], refused to aid the Jedi until Tano told them that her master, [[Anakin Skywalker]], was close to [[Death|dying]]. Wag Too then went with Tano and Bly while Secura stayed with his father. When they arrived at the crash site, Wag Too assisted Tano, Bly, and Captain [[Rex]] in subduing a [[mastiff phalone]]. Wag Too then treated Skywalker. After a stretcher was built, Wag Too and the other then returned to the village, where he uses oil from a [[seed pod]] to heal his wounds.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

Wag Too then helped the Jedi and the [[Cloning|clones]] hide when a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[C-9979 landing craft|landing ship]] landed at the village. Wag Too and the Jedi then watched as [[battle droid]]s under [[General]] [[Lok Durd]] searched the village for weapons or [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] contraband. After the Jedi and Durd left, Wag Too spoke with his father. He did not like his father allowing them to be harassed by the Separatists, despite the temporary peace.<ref name="DoP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>

Wag Too then sent one of his friends to follow the Jedi. When news came that the Separatists were returning, Wag Too suggested they should defend themselves. However, he respected his father's wishes. During the [[Defense of Maridun|attack]], Wag Too and the other villagers stood by until the battle droids were overwhelming the Jedi and [[Clone trooper|clones]]. They then, despite Tee Watt Kaa's objection, assisted Tano in defeating the [[droid]]s by knocking them down. After Durd was captured, Wag Too thanked the Jedi before they departed.<ref name="DoP" />

==Personality and traits==
Wag Too was a Lurmen [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> who was 1.03 [[meter]]s, or 3 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches tall,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s. He was a young Lurmen healer and the son of the village leader Tee Wat Kaa. His father assigned him to help the wounded Anakin Skywalker recovery from his injuries.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> After the Separatists arrived on Maridun, he became inpatient with his father's [[Te Padka|peaceful approach]] and decided he would fight back against Lok Durd's droids when they attacked the Lurmen colony. He used his speed and agility to help the Jedi and clones defeat the droids.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Skills and abilities==
Wag Too known for his skills as a healer. He also was very agile and was skilled as a scout.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Equipment==
Kaa used [[Ascension cable]]s during the Defense of Maridun.<ref name="DoP" />
